description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ElementDef, which represents an HTML element definition within the HTMLPurifier library. The class contains properties for element attributes, content models, child definitions, and methods for merging definitions, indicating its role in the configuration and validation of HTML elements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ElementDef
classes.description: Represents an HTML element definition used for validation and configuration within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new HTMLPurifier_ElementDef with specified content model, content model type, and attributes.

methods.name: mergeIn
methods.description: Merges another element definition into this one, with the other definition's values taking precedence where applicable.
